text:
sasha: bringing up a new PTQ cross-encoder (q4-ce-v2) on rerank-dev. quick smoke looks fine but long-context bucket MRR cratered :thinking:
maya: what numbers are you seeing?
sasha: comparing fp16 -> q4 export (same candidate generator) across doc-length buckets:
sasha: 0-128  MRR 0.421 -> 0.417
sasha: 128-512 MRR 0.398 -> 0.395
sasha: 512-2048 MRR 0.372 -> 0.368
sasha: >2048  MRR 0.298 -> 0.241  <-- huge regression
raj: that big tail drop usually points at either tokenization/truncation or candidate-slicing mismatch. did export change any offset/pad behavior?
sasha: interestingly, candidate recall for >2048 fell from 98% -> 92% after q4 export. so reranker not seeing the same candidates for some queries
eva: candidate recall change could be caused by a tokenizer build difference, or by export truncation settings (we sometimes align to 8-byte boundaries in kernels)
joe: also consider sliding-window logic. if the export changed hidden-size mod alignment, the slice offsets could shift and break mapping to candidates
maya: easy isolation plan: run fp16 weights with the q4 tokenizer build. if that reproduces, tokenizer/export step is culprit.
raj: for stats, run stratified bootstrap per-bucket. our quick script: 
python -c "from bootstrapped import bootstrap; print(bootstrap(data_fp16, data_q4, metric='mrr'))"
raj: for CI-level rigor do 10k resamples and report p-values and CI per bucket
ci-bot: build #ci-rerank-evals failed on q4-ci job: longdoc-slice-integration test. logs: https://ci.redwood/s/1234
eva: I'll run a Dedicated pool job and 3 ablations: (A) fp16 baseline, (B) fp16 weights + q4 tokenizer, (C) q4 weights + fixed-export-truncation. ETA ~3h :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sasha: nice. if (B) matches (A) -> tokenizer; if (C) recovers -> export bug; if neither -> numeric change in attention/kernels across long KV chains
maya: please include ndcg@1,5,10 + per-query-length scatterplots. want to know if failure is concentrated on a few queries or continuous drift across lengths
joe: short-term mitigations: 1) route >2048 docs to fp16 model, 2) loosen pruning thresholds in candidate generator for long docs to recover recall, 3) use long-context runtime variant on Dedicated for tail traffic
sasha: agreed. I'll kick off eva's ablation and attach the export config + tokenizer build sha to the run. dataset: rerank-dev-v3 (50k queries), seed=42, 10% holdout for stats
eva: export config used: /configs/exports/q4-ce-v2/2026-03-19.yaml (will attach full content to the job run)
raj: once results are in, run per-query diagnostic: top-k rank delta, tokenization diffs, and slice-id overlap heatmap so we can eyeball misalignment
sasha: CI note: make sure the integration test compares candidate hashes before and after export to catch slice-level shuffles early
maya: good call. also add a smoke that validates kv-cache continuity for a synthetic long doc (length 12k tokens) to ensure attention chaining isn't dropping tokens
joe: logging/stats to collect in the run: candidate_recall, mrr, ndcg@1/5/10, per-query len, failed_queries list, tokenizer-diff-hashes
sasha: will post experiment gist + links here when done. thanks team :rocket:
